definitions.raw_field_missing: Empty CSV cell, reported by MsgType; required fields follow replay needs, so optional trade-only/order-only columns are excluded from the required-field rate.
definitions.unknown_order_event: MsgType 31 or 32 refers to an OrderID absent from the current tolerant MBO reconstruction state; counts events, not provably lost messages.
definitions.time_gap: Two consecutive SendTime values in the same continuous HK trading session differ by more than 30,000 ms; this detects suspicious quiet intervals, not exact missing-message counts.
definitions.cache_scope: The July/August reconstruction metadata may come from raw files not present in this checkout; local raw availability is reported per date.
